summary: اعمال محافظ مسیر مشترک روی ابزار مستقل کپی CLI و بررسی backup پیش از توقف IIS و جابه‌جایی مقصد.
limitations: Same-content coordination depends on filesystem share-lock semantics; aliases, nested roots and non-cooperating/older clients need environment review.
Remote WinRM service remains blocked by UI; no remote transaction/lock/recovery was enabled.
CLI independent manual backup/rollback and ancillary destructive helpers remain pending.
Automatic retention is deferred; retained backups and releases need capacity management.
No build or runtime validation was performed.
